req.title: Handle CORS pre-flight OPTIONS
req.statement: The system shall respond to OPTIONS requests with appropriate Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that OPTIONS requests to any endpoint return HTTP 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers headers. httpbin uses Flask-CORS or manual CORS handling. Tests cover: (1) positive — OPTIONS to a known endpoint returns 200 with both required CORS headers present and non-empty; (2) negative — OPTIONS to a non-existent path should still return a CORS-aware response (not 500); (3) boundary — OPTIONS with an Origin header triggers the pre-flight path and the Allow-Methods header enumerates at least the expected methods. Each test asserts exact status codes and exact header presence to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_get_endpoint_returns_200_with_cors_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create test client from httpbin.core app
Send OPTIONS request to /get with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_preflight_options_get_endpoint_returns_200_with_cors_headers():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    allow_headers = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
    assert allow_methods != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods must be present and non-empty'
    assert allow_headers != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers must be present and non-empty'
    assert 'GET' in allow_methods.upper()

test_cors_preflight_options_get_endpoint_returns_200_with_cors_headers()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_post_endpoint_includes_post_in_allow_methods

actions: Create test client from httpbin.core app
Send OPTIONS request to /post with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method: POST
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: OPTIONS on POST endpoint must advertise POST in Allow-Methods
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_preflight_options_post_endpoint_includes_post_in_allow_methods():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.options(
        '/post',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'POST',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    assert allow_methods != ''
    assert 'POST' in allow_methods.upper()
    allow_headers = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
    assert allow_headers != ''

test_cors_preflight_options_post_endpoint_includes_post_in_allow_methods()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_not_500
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create test client from httpbin.core app
Send OPTIONS request to /get WITHOUT an Origin header
expected: Response status code is in 2xx range (exactly 200)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Error pathway — missing Origin should not cause server error
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_not_500():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.options('/get')
    assert r.status_code != 500, f'Got 500: {r.data}'
    assert r.status_code != 400, f'Got 400: {r.data}'
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'

test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_not_500()

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process

from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_preflight_options_allow_headers_reflects_requested_header():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.options(
        '/get',

            'Origin': 'http://boundary-test.example.com',

    assert r.status_code == 200
    allow_headers = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
    assert allow_headers != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers must not be empty'
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    assert allow_methods != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods must not be empty'

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_multiple_endpoints_all_return_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create test client from httpbin.core app
Send OPTIONS to /get, /post, /put, /delete, /patch each with Origin header
Assert each returns exactly 200 with CORS headers
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: OPTIONS /* — wildcard coverage across multiple method endpoints
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_preflight_options_multiple_endpoints_all_return_200():
    client = app.test_client()
    endpoints = ['/get', '/post', '/put', '/delete', '/patch']
    for path in endpoints:
        r = client.options(
            path,
            headers={
                'Origin': 'http://example.com',
                'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
                'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type'
            }
        )
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'{path} returned {r.status_code}, expected 200'
        am = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
        ah = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '')
        assert am != '', f'{path}: Access-Control-Allow-Methods missing'
        assert ah != '', f'{path}: Access-Control-Allow-Headers missing'

test_cors_preflight_options_multiple_endpoints_all_return_200()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_allow_origin_wildcard_or_echo
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create test client from httpbin.core app
Send OPTIONS to /get with Origin: http://example.com
Assert Access-Control-Allow-Origin is present in response
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: CORS pre-flight must include Access-Control-Allow-Origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cors_preflight_options_allow_origin_wildcard_or_echo():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    allow_origin = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '')
    assert allow_origin != '', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin must be present'
    assert allow_origin in ('*', 'http://example.com'), (
        f'Unexpected Allow-Origin value: {allow_origin!r}'
    )

test_cors_preflight_options_allow_origin_wildcard_or_echo()
